notes:
Status: active evaluation — heavy focus on real-time personalization (sub-100ms p95 ideal for some user flows).

Key business drivers:
- Reduce inference cost for personalized recommendations while keeping sub-100ms tail latency for mobile requests.
- Replace brittle in-house heuristics + batch jobs with model-driven scoring at request time.

Tech summary / requirements (from SE call):
- Workload: per-request reranking and short-form generation for insertion into ad slots; ~1200 sustained req/s expected for North America peak.
- Latency targets: p50 15-25ms, p95 < 60ms (for top-tier customers). Some non-critical flows can tolerate 150-200ms.
- Throughput requirements: peak 1200 rps, baseline 300 rps.
- Cost sensitivity: aim to halve current per-1k-request spend vs existing hosted vendor; want clear tradeoffs (quantization vs accuracy).
- Model preferences: open-models first (Llama2 variants, Mistral), will consider Redwood-verified models if latency/cost wins. Interested in 4-bit/8-bit quantization but must validate perf/regression.
- Batching/caching tolerance: micro-batching acceptable for some internal flows (10-20ms batching windows); interactive user flows require near-zero batching. Strong interest in prefix KV caching for repeat context.
- Routing/fallback: need deterministic fallback to smaller model variant if latency/queueing spikes; prefer policy-based routing per-customer tier.

Security/compliance:
- Must integrate with customer SSO via SAML; enterprise customers require audit logs and 1 year retention on access logs.
- EU micro-market customers require data residency in eu-west-1; will evaluate Redwood Private/VPC option for that region.

Perf benchmarking ask (explicit):
- Redwood to run controlled perf runs (P95/P50, throughput, tokens/sec, cost-per-1k-requests) across the three model/quantization pairs. Provide both pure latency-focused configs and cost-focused configs.
- Provide profiling breakdown: kernel time, KV cache hit rate, batching-induced added latency, and memory footprint.
- Provide recommendations: batching window, min_batch_size, cache TTLs, and quantization profile for each model.

Sales/ops notes:
- Champion: CTO Rina Delgado (very technical, will sign off on perf numbers).
- Buying committee: CTO, VP of Ads Product, Head of Infra (security). Procurement on 3rd week of June.
- Quote asked: anchor numbers for Hosted + Dedicated baseline; interest in pilot (3-month reserved) if perf/cost thresholds met.

Quotes and call paraphrase:
- "If we can hit p95 under 60ms with reasonable cost, we can consolidate three scoring clusters into one model-driven pipeline." — Rina (CTO)
- AE note: they are pragmatic about small accuracy regressions if cost wins are >30%.

Open items:
- Redwood to confirm EU residency option and operational model for Private deployment.
- Need Redwood benchmark runbook and expected measurement window (they prefer 24h steadystate + short spike tests).
- Confirm support SLA for dedicated pools and escalation path (SE asked for Jira escalation flow).
